scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build:types
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler d1 execute agrosprout-db --local --file=seed/local.sql
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply agrosprout-db --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply agrosprout-db-preview --remote --env preview && wrangler deploy --env preview
